So there by 2008; its start not found (its own site has no year). Today at 42 Park Avenue, Madison (Jewish Federation of Greater MetroWest). Its chabad.org listing went up Jul 22 2004, so it existed by then. The IRS ruling (Dec 2007) comes after the listing, so it is not the year (Nov 10 re-check of the filings sweep).
